//: EMULATOR-ONLY config for the Mercado Livre backend integration lane (ci-mercado-livre.yml: `firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.mercado-livre.json --only firestore`). ⚠️ NOT the deploy config — that is `firebase.mercado-livre.deploy.json`, one dot away, which is the only one of the two carrying a functions block. Read that filename character by character before running any deploy: the two differ solely by the `.deploy` segment. This file deliberately declares NO rules path, NO indexes path and NO functions, so a stray `firebase deploy` against it can push NOTHING (CLAUDE.md critical rule 2: deploy is manual and coordinated; agents never run it). Rules are irrelevant here anyway — the suite drives the Admin SDK, which bypasses them; rules coverage is ci-rules.yml's job. Indexes are irrelevant too: the emulator auto-creates every composite, so this lane CANNOT prove an index is declared in firestore.indexes.json — that is guard C/D in packages/data/src/admin/notifications/notificationGuardrails.test.ts. Firestore listens on 8082 so this lane coexists locally with firebase.functions.json (8080) and firebase.rules.json (8081).
